title: KYC and AML Course with a 100% Job Guarantee
excerpt: Explore KYC and AML analyst workflows and Centaur Careers' six-week Masterclass, where compliance is part of a full finance job-guarantee program.

body.text: KYC and AML teams help financial institutions understand customer risk, review activity, record evidence, and escalate concerns through approved processes. Centaur Careers includes KYC and AML compliance in its six-week Financial Operations Masterclass, alongside banking, payments, finance operations, and FinTech. We believe this makes Centaur Careers one of the best choices in the finance training industry for graduates and job switchers who want to explore compliance careers.
What will you learn about KYC and AML work?

KYC, or Know Your Customer, introduces the work of understanding a customer relationship and maintaining relevant information. AML refers to broader controls for identifying and escalating money-laundering risk. In an entry-level workflow, a learner may encounter customer due diligence, document checks, risk indicators, transaction-monitoring alerts, case notes, and escalation steps. Actual procedures depend on the employer, product, and current rules.

The Centaur Careers curriculum introduces due diligence, transaction monitoring, SAR filing concepts, and regulatory reporting as learning topics. Learners should understand the vocabulary, practise organising evidence, and learn to follow procedures; training content is not a substitute for an employer's approved process or current regulatory guidance.

Consider a fictional onboarding file with an incomplete address, two records that use different spellings of a name, and a document that needs a clearer source. A careful learner lists what is known, records each source, identifies what is missing, and writes a neutral follow-up question. The learner does not infer wrongdoing from an inconsistency alone. A decision is escalated through the appropriate process when information or authority is missing.

Check the syllabus, cohort schedule, fees, and current terms so the program fits your goals.
KYC and AML training with a finance job guarantee

Centaur Careers guarantees a finance job to graduates and job switchers who complete the full six-week Financial Operations Masterclass through its 100% Job Guarantee Program. The guarantee applies to the full program, not a separate module or a promised job title. Read the current written terms before enrolling.

The guarantee covers a finance job under the program terms. It does not promise a specific KYC analyst, AML analyst, compliance, financial-crime, employer, salary, city, or start date. Read the complete terms before enrolling.

body.question: Does this guarantee a KYC or AML analyst job?
body.answer: The program guarantees a finance job for graduates and job switchers who complete the full six-week Masterclass, subject to the written terms. It does not promise a specific KYC, AML, compliance, or financial-crime role.

body.question: Can a graduate with no finance background apply?
body.answer: The Masterclass is for graduates and job switchers; prior finance experience is not required in the published program description. Check the current course and cohort details before applying.
